description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) Champions of Fenris enhancement PREYSLAYER (WP-S2): the bearer's unit can re-roll charge rolls. Fixture sw11e_s2_wolves_active (Arjac Rockfist carries Preyslayer). Setup privileges: straight to the Charge phase (P1 active), CP 0 for both, the Gretchin placed ~9" north of Arjac. The charge panel lists Arjac; a real click picks him, the Gretchin are targeted, Declare Charge, Roll Charge (seeded): the re-roll dialog offers a FREE re-roll branded PREYSLAYER; a real click on Re-roll re-rolls the 2D6 without spending CP.
